context: Yumiko visits Sakura at college during a weekend.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: さくらちゃん、元気、そうね。
lines.style: Warm opening observation, delivered softly. A mother noticing something in her daughter's face. Gentle, genuine pleasure underneath. Slow enough to let the care show through.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お母さん、来てくれて、嬉しい。
lines.en: Mom — I'm so glad you're here.
lines.style: Sincere and unguarded. Relief breaking through at the opening. Soft voice, genuine warmth. Not performed — the real thing, simply said.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: Everyone in the family was worried about you.
lines.style: Honest, matter-of-fact delivery. No guilt-trip — just stating what is. Warm and steady. A mother comfortable saying hard truths softly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: I'm okay. Really. Every day is good.
lines.style: Bright and reassuring without being performative. A slight lift in the middle — genuinely wanting her mother to understand. Warm sincerity underneath the brightness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Gentle invitation, slow and warm. Not demanding — offering. The suggestion of something intimate and ordinary. A mother's way of saying: stay with me.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: I'm truly grateful for everything. Always.
lines.style: Quiet depth underneath. Sincere without being dramatic. The words matter and she knows it — soft delivery, steady. A daughter saying something she means.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: A closing statement, utterly simple and true. Quiet conviction. No hesitation or performance — just a mother naming what is. Warm enough to fill the room.
